title: ID0457912-DC/Si-D/FR-[MP / P0 170001107] OCPP Error
description:
Reported Behavior/Issue: OCPP Error: Router cannot connect to 4G = Network instability
Solution: W
e recommend first to reset the router locally and if the problem persists, please do as it's the easiest for you, either swap the SIM Card (operator) or replace the Router as a last resort
